Variant A: 200 conversions of 5,000 visitors. Variant B: 250 of 5,000. What is B's relative uplift and is the difference significant at 95% (z-test)?
```python
from math import sqrt
a,b,n=200,250,5000
pa,pb=a/n,b/n
p=(a+b)/(2*n)
z=(pb-pa)/sqrt(p*(1-p)*(2/n))
print(round((pb-pa)/pa*100), round(z,2), abs(z)>1.96)
```
questions.explain: z = difference / standard error; |z| above 1.96 is significant at 95%. (Illustrative numbers; real campaign results vary.) Verified by running it.
